review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that the news media have too much influence on people's lives today and this is a negative development. Personally, I also agree this view but not agree all.

Admittedly, one might argue that in right now, news media are much influence on people's lives today. In social now, the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet, these technologies allow people to follow the news instantly in wherever and whenever they are have the technologies and then, news are become a regular part of their routine. Therefore, this is the intense competition among news outlets. In order to gain attention, most media agencies focus on shocking and breaking content and then present it in a highly sensationalized manner. Besides, the news have dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals, therefore, it reinforce the overall impact of news on public opinion.

However, the news media have bad effect, but go futhermore, it can also bring good much for people. The news exposure to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news, and then, overwhelm people feel overly anxious and helpless. So, even in situations that do not directly affect them. Although it agree this view, news coverage also warn the public to existing and looming problems in society, such as a about crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. Individuals, better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threat. And then, it handle risks in an increasingly complex society.
In conclusion, although I can agree that news media have too much influence on people's lives, but it is not negative development for everyone.

completion.comment: Em đã viết đủ Introduction, hai Body và Conclusion trên trang đã xác minh.

review.overall: Em có đủ các ý và đủ bốn phần, nhưng bài còn ẩu ở khâu chuyển dàn ý thành câu: agree thiếu giới từ/trợ động từ, access bị bỏ dở, news are become, câu Individuals không có động từ, và nhiều từ nối ghép vào mảnh câu. Body 1 còn dùng lời người khác cho chính luận điểm em đang chứng minh. Em cần viết lại toàn bài, giữ nội dung đã có và tự soát từng chủ ngữ–động từ trước khi nối ý dài. Cô đã giữ cách triển khai cạnh tranh, tiêu đề và hình ảnh riêng của em.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that news reporting exerts an excessive influence on people’s daily lives and that this trend is harmful. Personally, I acknowledge this strong influence, although I believe its effects are not entirely negative.

Admittedly, news media have a considerable influence on people’s lives today. In society today, the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet allows people to follow the news instantly wherever and whenever they are; consequently, news has become a regular part of their routine. Moreover, intense competition among news outlets also increases the influence of news. In order to gain attention, most media agencies focus on shocking and breaking content and then present it in a highly sensationalized manner. Besides, the news has dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals; therefore, this presentation reinforces the overall impact of news on public opinion.

However, the news media have harmful effects, although they can also bring considerable benefits to people. Exposure to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news can overwhelm people and make them feel overly anxious and helpless, even in situations that do not directly affect them. Although I acknowledge these harmful effects, news coverage also warns the public to existing and looming problems in society, such as crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. Individuals are better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threats. As a result, these individuals can handle risks in an increasingly complex society.
In conclusion, although I acknowledge that news media have a considerable influence on people’s lives, I am convinced that this is not an entirely negative development.
